description: Hand-calculated scoring-correctness fixtures for earnings_signals.uncertainty.count_uncertainty. Expected values were computed BY HAND from the documented definition (see evals/README.md, 'Scoring definition') and the committed lm_uncertainty_terms.txt — NOT by running the implementation. Lexicon membership used in the calculations was verified against the committed term list. If the implementation and a fixture disagree, first re-check the hand calculation, then determine which side violates the documented definition; never edit an expectation just to make the test pass.

definition_under_test.tokenizer: regex [a-z]+(?:'[a-z]+)? over lowercased text: lowercase ASCII letter runs, internal apostrophe kept (contractions are single tokens). Numbers, punctuation and non-ASCII letters are not tokens; hyphenated compounds split.
definition_under_test.match: exact token membership in the 297-term LM uncertainty list (inflections only when listed; no stemming)
definition_under_test.negation: a match is excluded (tallied in negation_excluded) when any of the 3 tokens immediately before it is one of: no not never without don't doesn't didn't wasn't isn't aren't

fixtures.purpose: baseline: fluent sentence, zero lexicon hits, zero density
fixtures.text: Revenue grew nine percent and gross margins were stable.
fixtures.calculation: tokens: revenue grew nine percent and gross margins were stable (9); no token is in the lexicon

fixtures.purpose: case folding and punctuation stripping do not affect matching
fixtures.calculation: all four surface forms tokenize to 'risk' (in lexicon); 4/4 * 100 = 100

fixtures.purpose: every occurrence counts; repeated term is not deduplicated
fixtures.text: May I say that outcomes may vary, maybe widely.
fixtures.calculation: tokens: may i say that outcomes may vary maybe widely (9); hits: may, may, vary, maybe (all in lexicon; 'say','outcomes','widely' are not); 4/9*100

fixtures.purpose: inflections match only because the LM list carries them explicitly (risky, risked, riskier, risks, riskiness are all separate list entries)
fixtures.text: A risky bet risked little; riskier bets raise risks and riskiness.
fixtures.calculation: tokens: a risky bet risked little riskier bets raise risks and riskiness (11); hits: risky risked riskier risks riskiness (5); 'bet','bets','raise' not in lexicon

fixtures.purpose: QUIRK EXPOSED: numerals are not tokens, so they are excluded from total_tokens — density on number-heavy text is computed over words only
fixtures.calculation: tokens: in we see percent risk (5 — '2026' and '15' produce no token); hit: risk; 1/5*100 = 20

fixtures.purpose: QUIRK EXPOSED: hyphenated compounds split, so 'risk-adjusted' contributes a counted 'risk'; possessives keep the apostrophe, so "risk's" is one token that matches nothing
fixtures.text: Risk-adjusted returns offset the risk's rise.
fixtures.calculation: tokens: risk adjusted returns offset the risk's rise (7); hits: risk (from 'Risk-adjusted'); "risk's" is not a lexicon entry; 1/7*100

fixtures.purpose: negator two tokens back suppresses the match and is tallied separately
fixtures.text: There is no material risk to our guidance.
fixtures.calculation: tokens: there is no material risk to our guidance (8); 'risk' at index 4, window indexes 1-3 = is,no,material contains 'no' -> excluded ('material' is not a lexicon term)

fixtures.purpose: window edge: negator 2 and 3 tokens back still suppresses; note one negator suppresses BOTH terms in its reach
fixtures.calculation: tokens: no signs suggest risk (4); 'suggest' (lexicon term) at index 2, window = no,signs -> excluded; 'risk' at index 3, window = no,signs,suggest -> excluded ('signs' is not a lexicon term)

fixtures.purpose: window edge: a negator 4+ tokens back does NOT suppress (window is exactly 3)
fixtures.text: No early signals today suggest risk.
fixtures.calculation: tokens: no early signals today suggest risk (6); 'suggest' index 4, window = early,signals,today (the 'no' at index 0 is 4 back) -> counted; 'risk' index 5, window = signals,today,suggest -> counted; 2/6*100

fixtures.purpose: contractions act as negators; QUIRK EXPOSED: one negator suppresses every lexicon term within its 3-token reach, not just the term it governs
fixtures.text: We don't anticipate volatility, and we aren't cautious.
fixtures.calculation: tokens: we don't anticipate volatility and we aren't cautious (8); 'anticipate' idx 2 window we,don't -> excluded; 'volatility' idx 3 window we,don't,anticipate -> excluded (don't still in reach); 'cautious' idx 7 window and,we,aren't -> excluded

fixtures.purpose: QUIRK EXPOSED: the negator list omits cannot/can't/won't/couldn't/wouldn't, so semantically negated mentions still count under the current definition
fixtures.calculation: tokens: we cannot rule out risk (5); 'risk' idx 4, window cannot,rule,out contains no listed negator -> counted

fixtures.purpose: QUIRK EXPOSED: the tokenizer is ASCII-only, so accented words split into fragments and inflate total_tokens
fixtures.text: A naïve view of mañana risk.
fixtures.calculation: lowercased, [a-z]+ runs: a, na, ve ('naïve' splits at ï), view, of, ma, ana ('mañana' splits at ñ), risk = 8 tokens; hit: risk; 1/8*100

fixtures.purpose: denominator behavior: empty input yields zero counts and None density (not 0.0, not an error)
fixtures.calculation: no tokens; density is defined as None when total_tokens == 0

fixtures.purpose: denominator behavior: non-empty text with zero word tokens (numbers/punctuation only) also yields None density
fixtures.calculation: no [a-z] runs anywhere; same None-density branch as empty text

fixtures.purpose: integration: realistic sentence mixing counted terms, one negated term, and non-terms
fixtures.text: Operator: Thank you. Our outlook may vary, but we see no unusual exposures; demand appears durable and we believe risks are roughly balanced.
fixtures.calculation: tokens (23): operator thank you our outlook may vary but we see no unusual exposures demand appears durable and we believe risks are roughly balanced; hits counted: may(idx5), vary(6), appears(14; window unusual,exposures,demand), believe(18), risks(19), roughly(21); excluded: unusual(11; window we,see,no) and exposures(12; window see,no,unusual) — 'unusual' IS an LM uncertainty term, which the first draft of this calculation missed and the implementation caught (the disagreement was resolved by re-checking the lexicon, per the rule above); 6/23*100
